headline: Lemonade Stand Becomes Global Cancer Research Force
meta_description: Alex Scott's childhood lemonade stand has grown into a foundation that raised over $400 million for cancer research, funding more than 1,500 studies.
summary_short: What began as a four-year-old's lemonade stand has become a powerhouse for childhood cancer research, raising over $400 million and funding 1,500+ studies.
body:
A lemonade stand started by a four-year-old named Alex Scott has grown into a foundation that raised over $400 million for cancer research and funded more than 1,500 studies.

What makes Alex's story remarkable is the scale of impact that emerged from such a simple beginning. The foundation bearing her name has become a major force in the search for cancer cures, channeling decades of community support into concrete scientific progress.

The journey from a child's backyard entrepreneurship to a research powerhouse shows how individual action, even at the smallest scale, can ripple outward into meaningful change. Today, the foundation continues its mission nearly three decades after it began, proving that childhood inspiration can drive lifelong impact on medical science.
quick_facts: Alex Scott started a lemonade stand at age four
Foundation raised over $400 million for cancer research
Funded more than 1,500 cancer research studies
Impact continues 26 years after the stand began
